title: game/nouns.json
description: The noun catalogue: each noun of the world by its neutral id, with the target-language noun the game names, the item kinds and block kinds it stands for. Loaded by NounCatalog (Vocaterra.Game.Core).

generated_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (hand-authored).

id.description: The noun's neutral id (tree, wood, oven): what the world's data (recipes, objectives, stations, actions, procedures, host events, the scene's labels) names it by, in no language. Unique.

lemma.description: The target language's word for the noun: its lemma; the lexicon must have a noun reading of it with a gender.

items.description: The item kinds the noun names; each item kind belongs to one noun.

blocks.description: The block kinds the noun names.

labels.description: The text that labels one of the noun's items when it is not the lemma (roast-apple: manzana asada).

mass.description: A mass noun: the checklist shows the lemma, never the plural.

sources.description: The ids of the catalogue nouns this one is gathered from (wood from tree).

item.description: An item kind, by its stable name (ItemDefinition).

block.description: A block kind, by its stable name (BlockDefinition).
